description: A meter that draws each channel of a polyphonic cable as its own line, up to sixteen of them

inputs.text: The voltages to draw; each channel gets one line, and nothing is drawn while the jack is empty

notes: a line is white for a positive voltage, red for a negative one and grey at exactly 0V. A voltage past either end of the chosen range is drawn black at the end it ran past.
the module has no parameters and no outputs; the range and the drawing style are on its right-click menu.
menu: Mode: Horizontal, Vertical — draws each channel as a line across the panel at its voltage, or as a bar standing up from the zero line
Range: 0 .. +10, -10 .. +10, 0 .. +5, -5 .. +5 — sets the span the display covers; on the two ranges that reach below zero the zero line runs across the middle
